question: Do the two deposited baseline sparse triplets have consistent dimensions, keys, positive integer entries and technical feature-type/tag-signal accounting?
decision: Close a neutral input-integrity prerequisite and distinguish feature presence from observed tag signal, without cell assignments or biological effects.
strongest_rival: Mismatched feature/barcode axes, malformed entries or treating nonzero tag signal as assigned biological identity would misstate what the files support.
discriminator: Exact triplet hashes/dimensions/keys, coordinate/integer/entry-count validation, independent per-type arithmetic and explicit tag-coordinate duplicate accounting.
exposure_record: Paper and source_v1/v2 metadata plus completed human analyses are exposed. Original baseline files were previously downloaded/inventoried; this new job computes structural format diagnostics only. The full paper includes N.brasiliensis history and later IAV challenge; baseline is not absence of infection history.
biological_unit: Not applicable to this technical audit: files and rows. Mouse animal/pool identities and independence remain unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Rows nest in libraries; source-labeled libraries may contain pooled/overlapping material. No library or row is promoted to an independent animal.
population_and_selection: Only GSM9964560/count1 and GSM9964561/count2 baseline triplets. No later IAV-challenge matrix, no biological cell subset, no marker-based selection.
contrast: Exact file/row consistency and parser agreement only; no biological contrast.
endpoint: Dimensions, unique barcode and feature keys, positive integer/bounded stored coordinates, declared entry-count parity; technical counts by Gene Expression/Antibody Capture; per exact source CMO ID raw count sum, stored-entry count, unique positive barcode count and maximum stored entry.
methods: Read features/barcodes; stream each baseline sparse matrix once. Compare numpy integer/mask sums with pandas groupby. Tag unique positive-barcode counts use Boolean occupancy and independent sets; explicitly report stored-entry minus unique-coordinate duplication. Sum every stored tag entry, never infer an assignment. No ranking, thresholds, cell-to-condition/animal calls, group effects or infection-response models.
missingness_and_exclusions: No source rows/cells removed. Stop invalid/missing dimensions/keys/counts or coordinate violations. Tags with no entries remain zero rows. Duplicate stored tag coordinates remain included in total counts and are reported; positive barcode counts deduplicate them. Gene Expression coordinate duplication is not audited.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests, p-values or biological inference.
precision_basis: Exact structural accounting on deposited files, not population precision or power.
interpretation_limit: Passing file-format checks cannot establish unique gene/fragment semantics, biological independence, author-model equivalence, ATAC read-level QC, temporal mechanism or safety clearance of another task.
stop_rule: Stop exact-hash, axis/key, count/index, declared-entry or independent arithmetic conflicts; preserve partial outputs and failed receipt. Never turn technical tag signal into a condition or animal/pool crosswalk.
amendment_reason: Separately scoped neutral baseline sparse-integrity and tag-signal inventory, prospectively requested by reviewer; full study context and source identity holds retained.
